def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Input validation
    for arr in [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError("Input must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError("Input must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:
            raise ValueError("Input cannot be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError("Input must be finite")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError("Input must be nonpositive")
    shape = logp_with_result.shape
    if logp_call_only.shape != shape or logp_no_call.shape != shape:
        raise ValueError("Input shapes must match")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter cannot be boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite nonnegative")

    # Compute weights
    H = shape[1]
    t = np.arange(H, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    sum_w = np.sum(raw_weights)
    weights = raw_weights / sum_w

    # Weighted sums of log probabilities
    sum_no = np.dot(logp_no_call, weights)
    sum_call = np.dot(logp_call_only, weights)
    sum_result = np.dot(logp_with_result, weights)

    # Losses (negative log probabilities)
    L_no = -sum_no
    L_call = -sum_call
    L_result = -sum_result

    # Margin: reduction in loss compared to no call
    margin = L_no - L_result
    # Keep if margin exceeds threshold and result improves over call-only
    keep = (margin > tau_filter) & (L_call - L_result > 0.0)

    return keep, margin
